decisions.reason: It has remained fully presented after two selling seasons in a growing market, so the option value of keeping this close-to-core carpet line open still looks higher than the low cost of continuation.
As a premium hand-knotted carpet it is likely more niche and costlier to carry, but its continued dedicated presentation suggests enough unresolved upside to justify keeping it for now.
